feature: Save for later reads as a control
target: symphco/kindred PR #696 (fix/tap-affordances), code-only review of the merged diff

items.expectation: On a Life Story question, "Save for later" looks like a tappable control, not gray body text
items.note: The gray text is replaced by a heart icon and a semibold label in the primary brand color.

items.expectation: The control shows a saved state that is visibly different from the unsaved state
items.note: Saved shows a filled heart, unsaved an outline heart.

items.expectation: "Share a recipe" is sentence case everywhere it appears as a title
items.note: Both places that render the title changed: the create hub card and the recipe intro screen.

items.expectation: The recipe import failure title is warm and plain, not a capitalized system message
items.note: "Couldn't Read a Recipe" became "We couldn't read that recipe", the wording confirmed in the intent model.

items.expectation: The save control does not crowd or overlap the question text on a small phone
items.note: Layout needs a build on an iPhone SE-size simulator. The code adds a top margin and a row layout, which is a reasonable sign, but that is not evidence.

extras: A larger touch area around the save control (8 points on every side). Not asked for; a good call that costs nothing, worth knowing about.
bounds: code-only: reviewed from the merged diff, no build or simulator. Expectation 5 is the only visual one and stays CAN'T TELL until a build exists.
